name: reh11_hq_pollution_byte
description: REH test 15 [quirk]: the HQ decay adds the air curve at the low byte of the tract's average air pollution source: average 600 -> 600 & 0xFF = 88 -> HQdec = 0.2 + air(88) = 0.2 + 0.0171875 = 0.2171875; average 256 -> index 0 -> 0.2. No water or garbage pollution.
